facts.text: Undergraduates enrolled in Stevens Institute of Technology's cooperative education program do not pay tuition during their co-op work semesters.

sources.title: CO-OP PROGRAM FAQs | Stevens Institute of Technology
sources.quote: Students do not pay tuition during Co-op Work Semesters, but are required to pay General Service and Student Activity Fees during the Fall and Spring Co-op Work Semesters.
